end.summary: Discussed district courts, High Courts and the Supreme Court as levels in the court structure.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised identifying criminal and civil cases and explaining appeals from a district court to the High Court and then the Supreme Court. They used a football-referee and ladder analogy to connect with the ideas; they also stated that police file an FIR and take a criminal case to court. The reason criminal cases involve the state remained partly uncertain by the end; at home, practise drawing the three-level court ladder and adding one example of an appeal.
